scripts.build: pnpm --dir artifacts/prime-haven run build && pnpm run copy:dist
scripts.copy:dist: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }); if(fs.existsSync('artifacts/prime-haven/dist')){fs.cpSync('artifacts/prime-haven/dist', 'dist', { recursive: true });}"
scripts.serve: pnpm --dir artifacts/prime-haven exec vite preview --config vite.config.ts --host 0.0.0.0 --port 3000
